# MixtapeTools Imports

This folder contains external research tools imported into the Pbrugaro Research Suite.

Source fork: https://github.com/pablobrugarolas/MixtapeTools

Upstream source: https://github.com/scunning1975/MixtapeTools

These are vendored/imported copies from Pablo's fork of MixtapeTools. They are not Git submodules, so Git will not automatically update them when the upstream repo changes. To update, compare Pablo's MixtapeTools fork against Scott Cunningham's upstream repo, then re-import the relevant folders into this suite.

## gtd

Source path: https://github.com/pablobrugarolas/MixtapeTools/tree/main/gtd

Imported as an external source, with a suite-facing wrapper skill at `.codex/skills/pbrugaro-gtd`.

The GTD tool is a warrant-first research system for organizing hypotheses, insights, decisions, pipeline freshness, and courtroom-style checks for empirical causal claims.
